_about: Vendor types say what kinds of goods a vendor deals in; shops are the stock a particular vendor sells. Merchants buy anything sellable at CONFIG.shop.sellFraction of its price. Vendor types with `repairs` mend gear (Repair all).

vendorTypes.name: Smith
vendorTypes.description: A frontier smith: arms and armour, and the road supplies travellers ask for.
